name: Sea Cliff
summary: Ocean views, quiet streets and the Golden Gate on your doorstep.
description: Sea Cliff is one of the most private corners of the city, with grand homes above the ocean, China Beach below and the Golden Gate Bridge in view.
highlights: Ocean views, Beach nearby, Quiet and private

name: Noe Valley
summary: Family friendly, sunny and full of local shops.
description: Noe Valley is known for its sunny weather, Victorian homes and the cafés and boutiques of 24th Street, with parks and good schools close by.
highlights: Good schools, Local shops, Sunny weather

name: Pacific Heights
summary: Classic homes, city views and leafy parks.
description: Pacific Heights combines historic architecture with sweeping views of the bay, two large parks and the shops of Fillmore Street.

name: Downtown
summary: City living close to work, theaters and the best transit.
description: Downtown puts offices, shopping and entertainment on your doorstep, with modern apartments and great transit links.
